mitigation_descriptions: Manage and audit sudoers configurations to restrict unauthorized access to sensitive files like /etc/shadow.
Ensure strict file permissions are enforced on /etc/shadow so that only authorized root processes can access it.
Enforce strong password policies and frequent rotation to limit the utility of dumped password hashes.
reasoning: The adversary executed '/bin/cat /etc/shadow' via sudo on intranet-server using the account gmarsh, confirming credential dumping (T1003.008). Immediate containment and credential rotation are required to prevent lateral movement.
remediation_plan: 1. Isolate the affected host intranet-server (192.168.188.179) from the network to prevent lateral movement. 2. Terminate all active sessions associated with user account gmarsh. 3. Force an immediate password reset for user gmarsh and all local accounts whose hashes reside in /etc/shadow. 4. Audit and restrict the sudoers file on intranet-server to remove unnecessary privileges for /bin/cat or other utilities accessing sensitive files. 5. Review authentication and access logs around the incident time frame for any signs of subsequent lateral movement or persistence.
